What this site collects

The project form prepares an email locally in your browser. Meridius receives your name, email, business details, and message only when you send the email. This site does not request payment card details.

Why we use your information

We use information you send to respond to your enquiry, discuss your project, and administer any service agreement. Please do not include sensitive personal information in a project brief.

Concept-site forms

The eight sample sites are fictional demonstrations. Their forms do not send data, create bookings, take payments, or store submitted information.

Hosting and storage

The site is hosted on Vercel, which may process technical request information to provide hosting and security. Emails are handled through our Gmail mailbox. No advertising trackers or analytics scripts are included in this build.

Your choices

To ask about, correct, or request deletion of enquiry information, email meridiusai.agency@gmail.com. Project records may be kept where necessary to fulfil an agreement or applicable obligations.
